name: Stormcrown Keep
description: The corrupted fortress of the Warden-Commander known as the Stormcrown. Once the seat of the Warden order's mountain garrison, it has been twisted by the fracture energy of the shattered Seal. Lightning arcs through its halls, and the Stormcrown himself sits enthroned in the highest tower, neither alive nor dead.

rooms.name: Storm-Blasted Gatehouse
rooms.description: The gatehouse of Stormcrown Keep stands open, its iron portcullis fused in place by a lightning strike that left black scorch-marks radiating across the stone. Beyond the threshold, the air changes — colder, charged, tasting of ozone. The Warden sigil above the arch has been defaced, replaced by a crude storm-bolt carved deep into the granite.

rooms.name: Outer Ward
rooms.description: An open courtyard once used for mustering the garrison. The flagstones are cracked and heaved upward by the dark energy radiating from deeper within the keep. Skeletal remains of hitching posts and weapon racks line the walls. Rain lashes down from the perpetual storm overhead, pooling in the broken stones. Passages lead in every direction — west to a collapsed wing, east to the old armory.

rooms.name: Collapsed Wing
rooms.description: The western wing of the keep has partially caved in, the upper floors pancaked down into a treacherous slope of rubble and shattered timber. What was once the officers' quarters is now a maze of leaning walls and precarious overhangs. A few personal effects are visible among the debris — a tarnished mirror, a child's wooden toy brought from home, a half-crushed writing desk. The collapse appears to have been caused by a single massive lightning strike.

rooms.description: The keep's armory stands in eerie order, its weapon racks still filled with swords and halberds — all corroded black, as if bathed in acid. Lightning-shaped cracks run through the stone walls, and a faint violet glow pulses from the corrupted steel. The Wardens who died here left their arms behind, but something in the corruption has made the metal dangerous to touch.

rooms.name: Inner Ward
rooms.description: The inner courtyard of Stormcrown Keep is smaller and more oppressive than the outer ward. The walls here are higher, the stone darker, veined with the same purple energy that permeates the deeper keep. A well at the center has been sealed with iron plates, and the faint sound of something moving beneath them echoes upward. The air tastes of copper and rot.

rooms.name: Dungeon Cells
rooms.description: Iron-barred cells line both sides of a narrow corridor descending into the keep's underbelly. Most doors stand open, their occupants long gone — or worse. One cell at the end still shows claw marks gouged deep into the stone walls from the inside. The drain grate in the floor is choked with something dark, and the smell is indescribable. Whatever Stormcrown kept down here was not treated kindly.

Scorch marks on the walls trace the path of something that moved through here at terrible speed, burning everything it touched.

rooms.description: The keep's chapel has been thoroughly desecrated and remade into something terrible. The altar has been cracked in half and rebuilt into a crude lightning rod that channels the storm's energy directly into the floor. The stained glass windows — once depicting the Wardens' founding oath — are shattered, and the storm howls through the gaps. Strange sigils have been burned into the stone floor in patterns that hurt to look at directly. The air here tastes of ozone and despair.

The tapestries on the walls depict the Wardens' victories, each one slashed through by something with claws.

rooms.description: Beyond the sealed door, the keep transforms. The stone here is darker still, veined with glowing purple lines like a living circulatory system. A massive iron rod runs floor to ceiling through the center of the room, crackling with continuous electrical discharge. The walls are lined with copper plates, green with age, that redirect errant bolts. The heat in here is intense, and the thunder is deafening — each strike shakes the entire room.

rooms.name: Stormcrown Throne
rooms.description: The heart of Stormcrown Keep — a vast circular hall beneath a domed ceiling that has been blown completely open to the storm. Rain lashes down through the gap, and lightning strikes the iron crown-shaped finial at the dome's apex with metronomic regularity, each bolt feeding the purple veins that web the walls. At the center of the hall stands a raised dais of fused black iron, and upon it, a throne wrought from the same metal. Beyond the throne, a passage has been blasted through the eastern wall — its edges scorched and vitrified by an energy discharge of incredible power. Through it, a descending stairway leads down into raw rock and darkness. The air from below carries a scent of ancient stone and something that predates the keep by millennia. The rubble could be cleared with sufficient strength.
